messages:
harper: quick alert 1: sample-sdk publish is blocked. regen-diff non-empty after a typegen bump and a couple of sample app auth/retry tests flaked. CI stopped at the regen check. @diego @anya

diego: can you drop the CI snippet + regen diff?

harper: ci-bot shows the failed job and the minimal diff. snippet below.

ci-bot: [build 6120] nodejs-sdk/regendiff-check failed

harper: ```diff
--- a/src/options.ts
+++ b/src/options.ts
@@ -8,7 +8,7 @@
-  authRetry?: boolean;
+  authRetries?: number;
```

anya: that rename + type change explains the test flakes. tests assume exponential backoff with boolean toggle; new typegen defaults to numeric retries + linear backoff. was that a documented change?

diego: i checked the typegen release note for 3.2.0-candidate and it mentioned "retry API cleanup" but no clear migration steps. chglog was terse.

harper: CI runs linux-x64 with typegen pinned to 3.1.x in some packages, devs ran generator on mac/arm with 3.2 candidate, so we get both nondet ordering noise and a real semantics change.

anya: shortest unblock: pin @redwood/typegen to 3.1.x in SDK packages and push hotfix to unfreeze publishing. long-term: two followups: (1) require linux-x64 regen run in CI as part of publish checks to avoid platform nondet diffs, (2) add a pre-publish lint that heuristically flags renames/typing changes for fields containing keywords: "retry", "backoff", "auth", and require an explicit changelog entry if flagged.

diego: agree. also propose a tiny semantic-diff-check that compares previous published types and emits a warning for shape changes that look breaking (name change, type change) for critical keywords. we can gate publish on either an explicit sign-off or a changelog entry when detected.

harper: i've opened a hotfix branch sample-sdk/pin-typegen-3.1 and updated package.json/lock. running CI now.

ci-bot: rebuild queued: https://ci.redwood.dev/build/6121 :rocket:

anya: can you also file a devex issue with repro steps (arm vs x64 run, exact commands, sample diff) and include suggested heuristics for the lint? i'll triage and schedule a small spike to prototype the check.

diego: will do. i'll also add a note to the release playbook: "run typegen in linux-x64 container before tagging; check for retry/backoff/auth field diffs and require changelog entry for semantics changes".

harper: created devex issue #489 "typegen: detect auth/retry/backoff renames + require linux-x64 regen in CI" with logs and a suggested checklist. PR link for hotfix: https://github.com/redwood/sample-sdk/pull/421

anya: once hotfix merges we ship a patch to unblock users, then schedule a minor that intentionally bumps SDK surface to the new numeric retries and publishes a migration guide and changelog that calls out behavioral defaults (backoff strategy).

diego: small follow-up: let's avoid unit tests that assert internal backoff implementation in sample apps; test the public contract only (e.g., that retries occur, not how). i'll open a tiny PR to soften those asserts.

harper: agreed. thanks team 1 :sparkles:
